findings.finding: Card Kingdom's January 2026 support policy says ordinary buylist submissions are English-only and non-English items need buyer approval through its collections channel.
findings.implication: Do not transfer an English buylist price to a Japanese card. For special Phyrexian-script treatments, require an exact listed product or explicit exception; do not infer either acceptance or rejection from the generic language policy alone. No buyers have been contacted.

findings.finding: EDHREC derives deck statistics from Archidekt, Moxfield and Scryfall. Inclusion denominators depend on legal eligibility, dates and active filters; updates replace previous deck versions, and coverage is not guaranteed complete.
findings.implication: Use deck inclusion as a dated gameplay-interest signal with denominator and filters. It is not sales velocity or demand for a particular premium printing. Do not sum successive snapshots as new decks.

findings.finding: TCGplayer describes Market Price as a recent-sales-based aggregate with outlier handling, rather than a currently listed asking price.
findings.implication: Retain metric identity and upstream lineage when imported through other services. An aggregate is neither an executable buy offer nor transaction-level volume and does not establish exact-language comparability by itself.
